notes.title: Hop Into the Froggy Sale And Follow For New Updates! 🐸
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Toadled fans![/h2]
We’re thrilled to announce that Toadled Classic is part of the epic [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44758638/sale/froggy-sale/?curator_clanid=4777282]Froggy Sale[/url], where you can snag the game at a discount alongside a bunch of other ridiculous, frog-themed adventures. Whether you’re hopping through classic toad chaos or checking out some new amphibious friends, this sale is the perfect excuse to dive back into the pond!

[h2]Why Stop There?[/h2]
We’ve got something even more exciting on the horizon for Toadled fans. While we can't say much yet, let's just say there’s a lot more eating, growing, and mayhem on the way. Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming updates and a brand new take on your favorite hungry toad! 🐸✨ (Hint: early concept art included below 😉)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/ff73c6e855aa9351ef529fd3dbf9f548e4c8573f.png[/img]

[h2]Don’t Miss a Ribbit[/h2]
Follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33746645]Steam Dev page[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/Ntc9dkVb4T]join our Discord [/url]to get the latest news, playtest invites, updates, and more sneak peeks at what’s coming soon. Trust us, you won’t want to miss this!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33746645][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/bc4b467543f4e33974084e8924158667972bcb5f.png[/img][/url]
